// Hydration preserves this seed until AppearanceProvider takes over.
/** @param {string} browserThemeCacheKey */
// oxlint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars -- The raw source is called by browser-theme-bootstrap.ts when constructing the inline script.
function initializeBrowserTheme(browserThemeCacheKey) {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const preference = root.dataset.appearanceTheme;
  if (preference === "light" || preference === "dark") {
    root.dataset.theme = preference;
  } else {
    root.dataset.theme = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)")
      .matches
      ? "dark"
      : "light";
  }
  try {
    const themes = JSON.parse(
      window.localStorage.getItem(browserThemeCacheKey),
    );
    if (
      typeof themes?.css === "string" &&
      typeof themes.light === "boolean" &&
      typeof themes.dark === "boolean" &&
      // The origin-wide cache may belong to a different user or workspace.
      themes.accountId === (root.dataset.themeAccountId ?? null) &&
      themes.userId === (root.dataset.themeUserId ?? null)
    ) {
      document.querySelector("style[data-codex-app-themes]").textContent =
        themes.css;
      root.classList.toggle(
        "chatgpt-theme",
        themes[root.dataset.theme] === true,
      );
    }
  } catch {
    // Unavailable storage or an invalid cache leaves the default palette intact.
  }
}

(() => {
  const key = "oai-epic-native-launch";
  let launch = null;
  try { launch = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(key) || "null"); } catch {}
  function save() {
    try {
      if (launch) sessionStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(launch));
      else sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
    } catch { launch = null; }
  }
  function capture() {
    const fragment = window.location.hash;
    if (!fragment) return;
    window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, "", "/epic/launch");
    const params = new URLSearchParams(fragment.slice(1));
    const snapshot = params.get("snapshot");
    const workspace = params.get("workspace_id");
    launch = Array.from(params).length === (workspace ? 2 : 1) && (!workspace || /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$/.test(workspace)) && snapshot &&
      /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{80,16384}={0,2}$/.test(snapshot)
      ? { snapshot, workspace, id: crypto.randomUUID(), messageId: null, draftId: null } : null;
    save();
  }
  if (window.location.pathname === "/epic/launch") capture();
  function pending() {
    return launch && !launch.draftId && new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("epic_launch") === launch.id
      ? launch.snapshot : null;
  }
  window.__oaiEpicNativeLaunch = {
    get: () => launch?.snapshot ?? null,
    workspace: () => launch?.workspace ?? null,
    destination: () => launch ? "/?surface=work&epic_launch=" + launch.id : "/epic/launch",
    pending,
    ownsMessage: (messageId) => launch?.messageId === messageId,
    metadata: (messageId, draftId) => {
      if (!launch) return;
      if (draftId != null) {
        if (launch.draftId ? launch.draftId !== draftId : !pending()) return;
        launch.draftId = draftId;
      } else if (launch.messageId !== messageId) return;
      const changed = launch.messageId !== messageId;
      launch.messageId = messageId;
      save();
      if (changed) window.dispatchEvent(new Event("oai-epic-launch-changed"));
      return launch ? { epic_launch_snapshot: launch.snapshot } : undefined;
    },
    claimAttachmentNotification: (expected) => {
      if (!launch || launch.snapshot !== expected || launch.attachmentNotified) return false;
      launch.attachmentNotified = true;
      save();
      return true;
    },
    clear: (expected) => {
      if (launch?.snapshot === expected || launch?.messageId === expected) {
        launch = null;
        save();
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("oai-epic-launch-changed"));
      }
    }
  };
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => {
    if (window.location.pathname !== "/epic/launch" || !window.location.hash) return;
    capture();
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("oai-epic-launch-changed"));
  });
})();

class="MarkdownRoot-rZKhxa [&amp;&gt;*:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;&gt;*:last-child]:mb-0 text-size-chat" style="--markdown-link-color: currentColor;"><h1 class="Heading-Ro3lZr" dir="auto">AI for Marketing — Customer Analytics &amp; Predictive Modeling</h1><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto"><strong class="font-semibold">University project | AI for Communication and Marketing | BSc in Artificial Intelligence | 2025/2026</strong></p><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto">This project explores how customer data and machine learning can support marketing decisions. It brings together three analyses: customer segmentation, churn prediction, and customer lifetime value (CLTV) estimation. Each part includes a Jupyter notebook documenting the analysis and a short presentation translating the findings into proposed marketing actions.</p><h2 class="Heading-Ro3lZr" dir="auto">Project overview</h2><div class="group/app-widget pointer-coarse:pt-11 [@media(hover:none)]:pt-11 TableContainer-UfIOz_" data-markdown-table="true" tabindex="-1"><div class="TableScroller-ZhMTLB" data-horizontal-scroll="true"><div class="TableWrapper-i1mUIE"><table class="Table-LqdUhs" dir="auto"><thead><tr class="TableRow-ENsaGm"><th class="TableHeaderCell-esYSpn SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="sm">Part</th><th class="TableHeaderCell-esYSpn SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="md">Business question</th><th class="TableHeaderCell-esYSpn SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="md">Methods</th><th class="TableHeaderCell-esYSpn SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="md">Marketing output</th></tr></thead><tbody class="TableBody-A5sMNL"><tr class="TableRow-ENsaGm"><td class="TableCell-WcsygL SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="sm"><strong class="font-semibold">1. Customer Segmentation</strong></td><td class="TableCell-WcsygL SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="md">Who are the customers, and how do their behaviors differ?</td><td class="TableCell-WcsygL SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="md">Exploratory data analysis, RFM scoring, K-Means clustering</td><td class="TableCell-WcsygL SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="md">Customer profiles and differentiated communication proposals</td></tr><tr class="TableRow-ENsaGm"><td class="TableCell-WcsygL SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="sm"><strong class="font-semibold">2. Churn Prediction</strong></td><td class="TableCell-WcsygL SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="md">Which customers are at risk of leaving?</td><td class="TableCell-WcsygL SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="md">Logistic Regression, Random Forest, classification metrics and feature importance</td><td class="TableCell-WcsygL SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="md">Proposed early-life retention program</td></tr><tr class="TableRow-ENsaGm"><td class="TableCell-WcsygL SingleChildTableCell-Sv7jTC" dir="auto" data-col-size="sm"><strong class="font-semibold">3. border-transparent size-9 justify-center border-0 p-0" aria-label="Copia tabella"><span class="CompactSource-d7ZD01" aria-hidden="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="Icon-X4VkKC" focusable="false" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><use href="/cdn/assets/icons-a37f3c54c7d1d31c.svg#square-on-square-light-16" fill="currentColor"></use></svg></span><span class="LeadingSource-d79mNZ" aria-hidden="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="Icon-X4VkKC" focusable="false" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><use href="/cdn/assets/icons-a37f3c54c7d1d31c.svg#square-on-square-light-20" fill="currentColor"></use></svg></span></button></span></div></div><h2 class="Heading-Ro3lZr" dir="auto">Part 1 — Customer Segmentation &amp; Communication Strategy</h2><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto">Analyzed a retail marketing dataset, including customer demographics, spending, campaign response, and purchasing channels. After auditing and preparing the data, I used <strong class="font-semibold">RFM segmentation</strong> and <strong class="font-semibold">K-Means clustering</strong> to identify customer groups and compare their behavior.</p><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto">The presentation summarizes three K-Means customer archetypes and proposes differentiated communication approaches for loyal, at-risk, and less responsive customers.</p><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto"><strong class="font-semibold">Files:</strong> <span data-markdown-copy="inline-code" class="InlineCode-Cddi3Y InlineMarkdownIsolate-QWDV4W" dir="ltr">customer-segmentation/customer_segmentation.ipynb</span> and <span data-markdown-copy="inline-code" class="InlineCode-Cddi3Y InlineMarkdownIsolate-QWDV4W" dir="ltr">customer-segmentation/presentation.pdf</span></p><h2 class="Heading-Ro3lZr" dir="auto">Part 2 — Customer Churn Prediction &amp; Retention Strategy</h2><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto">Built and evaluated churn classification models using <strong class="font-semibold">Logistic Regression</strong> and <strong class="font-semibold">Random Forest</strong>, with attention to class imbalance and recall. Explored factors associated with churn, including customer tenure and complaints, and examined feature importance and lift.</p><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto">The presentation proposes a <strong class="font-semibold">“First 180 Days” retention program</strong> focused on customers early in their lifecycle. The tuned Random Forest result reported in the presentation is <strong class="font-semibold">0.874 recall</strong> on the evaluated dataset; it is an experimental result, not evidence of campaign effectiveness.</p><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto"><strong class="font-semibold">Files:</strong> <span data-markdown-copy="inline-code" class="InlineCode-Cddi3Y InlineMarkdownIsolate-QWDV4W" dir="ltr">churn-prediction/churn_prediction.ipynb</span> and <span data-markdown-copy="inline-code" class="InlineCode-Cddi3Y InlineMarkdownIsolate-QWDV4W" dir="ltr">churn-prediction/presentation.pdf</span></p><h2 class="Heading-Ro3lZr" dir="auto">Part 3 — Customer Lifetime Value &amp; Marketing Strategy</h2><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto">Analyzed the <strong class="font-semibold">Olist e-commerce dataset</strong> to estimate future value within the existing customer base. Compared probabilistic <strong class="font-semibold">BG/NBD + Gamma-Gamma</strong> modeling with <strong class="font-semibold">XGBoost</strong> and <strong class="font-semibold">Random Forest</strong> regression, and examined model evaluation, repeat-purchase patterns, and customer ranking.</p><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto">The presentation proposes CLTV-based retention and win-back segments. An important interpretation caveat is that revenue from <strong class="font-semibold">newly acquired customers</strong> in the holdout period is outside the prediction scope of models built for the existing customer base; total marketplace revenue is therefore not a like-for-like target for those predictions.</p><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto"><strong class="font-semibold">Files:</strong> <span data-markdown-copy="inline-code" class="InlineCode-Cddi3Y InlineMarkdownIsolate-QWDV4W" dir="ltr">customer-lifetime-value/customer_lifetime_value.ipynb</span> and <span data-markdown-copy="inline-code" class="InlineCode-Cddi3Y InlineMarkdownIsolate-QWDV4W" dir="ltr">customer-lifetime-value/presentation.pdf</span></p><h2 class="Heading-Ro3lZr" dir="auto">Tools and techniques</h2><ul class="List-kOVW5V UnorderedList-nqKD7g" dir="auto"><li class="ListItem-ncLgmg"><strong class="font-semibold">Python:</strong> pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib and related analysis libraries</li><li class="ListItem-ncLgmg"><strong class="font-semibold">Segmentation:</strong> RFM, K-Means, exploratory data analysis</li><li class="ListItem-ncLgmg"><strong class="font-semibold">Prediction:</strong> Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost</li><li class="ListItem-ncLgmg"><strong class="font-semibold">CLTV:</strong> <span data-markdown-copy="inline-code" class="InlineCode-Cddi3Y InlineMarkdownIsolate-QWDV4W" dir="ltr">lifetimes</span> (BG/NBD and Gamma-Gamma)</li><li class="ListItem-ncLgmg"><strong class="font-semibold">Communication:</strong> visual analysis, presentation of findings, and marketing recommendations</li></ul><h2 class="Heading-Ro3lZr" dir="auto">Repository structure</h2><div Their existing data paths may need to be adjusted before running the notebooks in a new environment. See each notebook's data-loading section for the expected filenames and input structure. The Olist analysis uses the publicly known Olist e-commerce dataset; the other datasets should be checked for redistribution rights and accurate attribution before being uploaded.</p><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto">The PDF presentations summarize the results of the analyses as submitted for the university lab exam. The recommended marketing actions are <strong class="font-semibold">proposals based on the analyses</strong>, not deployed or A/B-tested campaigns.</p><h2 class="Heading-Ro3lZr" dir="auto">Context</h2><p class="Paragraph-kKnbIo" dir="auto">Academic lab examination for <strong class="font-semibold">AI for Communication and Marketing</strong>, Bachelor's degree in Artificial Intelligence (academic year 2025/2026).</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 end-0 grid min-h-0 max-w-full min-w-0 pt-13"></div></div></div></section></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></aside></div></main></div><div id="DndDescribedBy-0" style="display: none;">
